title: Density sum over a fibre with at least two points (Simon Ch. 8, 5.11(∗) from (8))
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^N, P ∈ G(N,n), x ∈ ℝ^N, s ⊆ ℝ^N finite, Θ : ℝ^N → [0,∞], K, c, δ, ε ∈ ℝ and M ∈ ℕ, with K ≥ 0, c ≥ 0, 0 < δ ≤ 1/2, 0 < ε ≤ δ⁴. Let ω_n := unitBallVolume n, ω := ω_n.toReal, A := 2 + 2c + 2c/ω + 2MK/ω, and assume Aδ ≤ 1 and 2 ≤ #s ≤ M. With U^t_r(y) := B_r(y) ∩ {z : |(z − y) − p_P(z − y)| < t} (closed balls), assume: for every y ∈ s, |y − x| < ε and Θ(y) ≤ (e^ε·μ(U^{4τ}_σ(y))/σ^n + Kεσ/τ)/ω_n for all τ ∈ (0,1/4], σ ∈ (0,1); and (CB) for all σ, τ ∈ ℝ with 0 < σ ≤ δ², 2δ²σ ≤ τ and 4τ ≤ |y − y'| for all distinct y, y' ∈ s: Σ_{y∈s} μ(U^τ_σ(y))/σ^n ≤ (1 + cδ²)μ(B_1(x)) + cδ². Then Σ_{y∈s} Θ(y) ≤ (1 + δ)μ(B_1(x))/ω_n + δ in [0,∞].
